text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: C210 · The economics of fibre and the data-communications market trend

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Book Sec. 1.3.1 Data communication · SiPh = silicon photonics · HPC = high-performance computing · panels 1 and 3 are schematic

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: 1 · Laying new fibre is the big cost

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Schematic relative costs, per link (no book numbers)

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Equipment at both ends: can be millions of $

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff9f0a

g.text: Lay fibre on land: right-of-way + conduits [31]

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff6961

g.text: Lay fibre across an ocean: 'frightfully expensive' [31]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: So millions spent on end-point gear to squeeze more data

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: through existing fibre is sensible: new fibre costs more.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: 2 · Fibre optics took over, long links first

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6
font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6
font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a1a1a6

font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Fibre-to-the-home: dominant in many countries; in the US it

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: still competes with DSL and other technologies.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #30d158

g.text: Why fibre won: (1) very low-loss fibre

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: (2) EDFA = erbium-doped fibre amplifier [32]: boosts every

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: wavelength in one window around 1.5 µm at once

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: 3 · Shorter reach → cheaper parts, far more of them

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Schematic trend, not data: price per part 'drops precipitously', volumes go up

g.text: 4 · Industry status (when the book was written)

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Not yet CMOS-industry scale, but becoming a significant industry

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: • First products joining chip electronics + photonics [35]

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: • Luxtera: millionth silicon-photonic data channel sold [37]

font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: made in the Freescale CMOS foundry, Texas [39]

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: • Intel: plans a standard optical format for personal computing

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: • Programs at Intel, Samsung, IBM, ST, startups, defence firms

g.text: Takeaway: new fibre is so costly that pricey endpoints pay off — and since shorter links

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: mean cheaper parts sold in far bigger volumes, silicon photonics aims first at data centres and HPC.
